english.title: Knowingly / recklessly provide false / misleading information in purported compliance with s.131E / 131F requirement
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), knowingly or recklessly provided information, namely **(..SPECIFY THE FALSE OR MISLEADING INFORMATION..), which was false or misleading in a material particular, in purported compliance with a requirement imposed under section

(A)_[131E]_
(B)_[131F]_

of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000
english.legislation: Contrary to section 131L(3) and (4) of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000.

other.penalty:
Summary: Three months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
